docusign-api.$comment: All requests to the DocuSign eSignature REST API: the account.docusign.com auth/userinfo host and the regional API hosts (e.g. na4.docusign.net, na4-app.docusign.net). Production only; demo/sandbox is not supported.

anyOf.$comment: The eSignature REST API on the regional hosts, e.g. /restapi/v2.1/accounts/{id}/envelopes. Only the API path prefix matches, not the rest of the host.
OAuth userinfo on the account host, used to resolve the account_id and base_uri (regional host). Only /oauth/ matches, not the rest of the host.

docusign-read-all.$comment: Read from the DocuSign eSignature API: list and inspect envelopes, templates, folders, recipients, and documents. Safe method only.

docusign-write-all.$comment: Write through the DocuSign eSignature API: create, send, correct, void, or delete envelopes, and manage templates and recipients. Any mutating method.
